entry_item.definition: n. and adj. Vacuum, emptiness; space, nothingness; nonentity; vanity; empty, void; poor, indigent; hungry.

example.definition: To become empty, poor, indigent, bankrupt, or insolvent; to become futile.
To go to sleep without eating.

entry_item.definition: T. stong pa nyid; S. çūnya. Empty; the VOID, the doctrine that "things" have no substance, no essence, no independent existence of any kind, but "exist" only as aggregates of conditions and relations. This view may be roughly described as relationism. It was given its systematic form by famous Nagarjuna (M. Naganzuna, Naγanzuna, transl. as Luus bytygsen, after T. Klu sgrubs, 2nd cent. A. D.)

example.definition: The realm of the VOID from which the bytygelcin evokes (urin zalaxu) the deities.

entry_item.definition: 1 le vide. espace vide, néant , nullité, rien, inanité, tout ca qui est depourvu de substance, immatérialité: vanité, futilité: 2 vide, qui n'est pas rempli, occupé, vain, futile, 3 absence, privation: 4 zéro: 5 dans le bouddhisme cc qui est étranger à toutes les qualités de la matière ou de l'esprit; la réunion interne et la concentration de l'intelligence; l'état de l'existence la plus parfaitement vraie absolue; abstraction. idée. Existence absolue et ses formes.

entry_item.definition: adj. Empty. Hollow. Void. Null, vain. Invalid. The 30th at the end of the month.

〔形〕①空的，空洞的，空虚的：~ өрөө 空房间；~ тал 荒无人烟的草原；~ ам 空话，不兑现的诺言；~ нэр 空名，虚名；~ үг 空话，无稽之谈；~ санаа 空想；~ санаа баримтлагч 空想家；~ санаашрал 幻想；~ санаашрагч 幻想家；~ зай 空行，空格；~ хуудас 空页，白页；~ батламж 空头支票，空许愿；~ вагон （铁路）空车厢；~ вакуум 〈理〉真空；~ эргэх 空转；~ цохилох 〈医〉虚脉；~ харих 空手归来；~ хонох 饿着肚子过夜；~ цай уух 单喝茶；гар ~ (1)空手，徒手，赤手空拳；(2)贫穷；~ буу 无子弹的枪；~ огторгуй 空间；хоосны туйл (1)空虚到极点，空洞到极点；(2)贫困到极点；赤贫；②贫穷的，赤贫的，贫苦的：~ хүн 穷人，贫苦的人，贫民，无产者；◊ ядуу ~, үгээгүү ~ 赤贫的，贫穷的；~ нойтон 贫穷的，饥饿的.
